title: PiccoloBASIC (RP2040 UART console)
notes: Gary Sims's PiccoloBASIC interpreter with a UART line editor for unnumbered BASIC source on the RP2040. RUN executes the listing, LIST shows it, NEW clears it, and Ctrl+C stops it. The UART monitor supports SAVE and LOAD with a quoted filename and FILES to list its 128 KiB LittleFS partition.
